page.layout: One page of text, one column, with the heading "PRÆFATIO." centred above it. A catchword sits at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: vicissim ne prætextu potestatis Magistratus asserendæ, huic ni-mium, ministris autem nimis parum tribuatur. Utriusq; & defectus & excessus character est, si res in Papatum abeat vel Hierarchicum vel Politicum. Hierarchicus Papatus est, quan-do ministerium in dominium convertitur ἀνυπεύθυνον[?] & ei non solum gubernatio interna, ut par est, attribuitur, sed etiam e-xterna, & Magistratus sub mi-nisterium ita deprimitur, ut vel Magistratus potestas circa Ec-clesiastica dependere statuatur à ministris, vel id quod Magi-

page.notes: The Greek word after "convertitur" is printed small and is hard to read; the reading ἀνυπεύθυνον is a guess and is marked [?]. The catchword "stratui" is printed at the lower right with the long s written as a plain s. The line "Hierarchicus Papatus est, quando ministerium in dominium convertitur" appears to be set in roman type, while the surrounding text is italic; I have followed the italic/roman distinction only where it is clear. No page number or running head is printed.
